title: Talented singer Jessy releases his recent track titled "Boy Scout"
htmlContent:
Born and raised in Berlin, Talented singer and songwriter Jessy is ready to take over the music scene with the release of his latest single, "Boy Scout." He started writing his music when things changed during the Corona Pandemic when he was all alone with his thoughts.

Jessy's "Boy Scout" is about getting lost in a chaotic world and doing everything possible to forget one's, old love. The record is truly in a class of its own, with a genre-blending sound that takes the listener to places they haven't been before.
